role.description: A tiled cube shows over its asset's preview cube, so it cannot be one.

encodedBytes.description: The prepared files' total bytes, six faces summed for a cube, every tile for a tiled cube.

warp.description: A face position s in -1 to 1 is the direction forward + w(s) right: w(s) = tan(s pi/4) equi-angular, s gnomonic.

faceSize.description: The finest level's face, texels: tileSize times 2 to the number of levels less one.

tileSize.description: A tile's logical texels a side.

gutter.description: Texels a stored tile adds on every side, sampled past its edge; less than half the tile size.

levelBytes.description: Encoded bytes of each level's tiles, level 0 first; they add up to encodedBytes.

url.description: The tiles' folder. Tile (face, level, x, y) is <url><face>/<level>/<x>/<y>.jpg, or .png.

extensions.description: Namespaced data for later features. Never executed.

id.description: Case-sensitive ASCII, unique in its scope.

url.description: http(s), absolute or relative to the manifest's final response URL; no credentials.
